sources.publisher: SPF Affaires étrangères, Commerce extérieur et Coopération au Développement

sources.publisher: SPF Affaires étrangères, Commerce extérieur et Coopération au Développement

policies.title: Belgian ordinary passports: Chad, Liberia and Niger advance visitor visas
policies.summary: Current Belgian Foreign Affairs guidance requires mission-issued visitor visas before travel for Chad, Liberia and Niger.
conditions: TD: apply to the Chadian Embassy in Brussels. LR: obtain the visa from the Liberian Embassy in Brussels before travel. NE: enter with a visa issued by the Nigerien embassy.
Work, residence, diplomatic or service passports, carrier checks and final admission remain separate from this ordinary short-visitor baseline.

policies.title: Belgian ordinary passports: Guinea-Bissau advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Belgian guidance says Belgian citizens need a Guinea-Bissau visa and identifies the missions in Brussels or Dakar as the issuance route.
conditions: Obtain the visitor visa from the Guinea-Bissau Embassy in Brussels or Dakar before travel; this is not border issuance.
Residence, work, transit, special passports, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Belgian ordinary passports: Iran arrival tourist visa
policies.summary: Current Belgian guidance says Belgian tourists may use Iran's tourist visa-on-arrival process at Tehran Imam Khomeini Airport, while strongly advising advance issuance.
conditions: The stated route is tourist-only arrival issuance at Tehran Imam Khomeini Airport. Belgium strongly advises obtaining the visa before travel because a visa is not a right of entry.
Dual Iranian nationality, Israeli visa history, work, residence, special passports, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Belgian ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Belgian guidance says a Jordanian visa can be obtained at border crossings, alongside embassy and electronic options.
conditions: Border issuance is unavailable at Allenby/King Hussein Bridge. The separately available electronic or Brussels-embassy routes do not change the stated border-issued baseline.
Aqaba charter-group arrangements, Jordan Pass, work, residence, transit, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Belgian ordinary passports: Sierra Leone arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Belgian guidance expressly makes a 30-day Sierra Leone visa on arrival at the airport available as an alternative to advance or online application.
conditions: The stated ordinary visitor route is issuance at the airport for 30 days. The separate online route does not turn an airport-issued visa into an eVisa.
Airport-security payment, health formalities, work, residence, special passports, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Belgian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free visitor access
policies.summary: Panama's official embassy immigration guidance lists Belgium among nationalities that need no visa and gives a three-month maximum tourist stay.
conditions: Visa-free for the listed ordinary Belgian-national visitor route for up to three months. Carry a passport valid for at least three months, onward travel and proof of funds if requested.
Employment, residence, transit, third-country visa or residence exemptions, special passports and final admission remain separate.
